vetting_note: Series-level cluster, not one cipher document, and the lead's unit numbers are wrong. Inventory 41bis (Wayback PDF read 6 Nov 2026) lists 'Legation Genoise a Paris' units by cassa and number; the lead fused them ('2 18' read as 218). Units marked 'Contiene doc. in cifra/cifre' are nos. 5, 6, 7 (1730-34), 18, 20, 25, 26, 28, 29, 31, 34, 35, 37 (1746-55), 54, 57, 59, 62, 65, 72 (1759-68), 88 (1792) and 90 (1794); no. 47 (1757) 'La carta 166 contiene un decifrante' and no. 89 (1793-94) 'Le cc. 126-132 contengono un cifrario'. Each volume mixes originals, copies and minutes of despatches to and from the minister, so the cipher pieces may be incoming letters already deciphered by the legation; nothing says how many leaves are cipher or whether decipherments accompany them. No edition or study found (web search on the Legation genoise volumes found only the ASGe inventory and the Quai d'Orsay restitution list); known.py 'Legation genoise', 'Manoscritti restituiti', '41bis': no hits. Not online. Needs splitting into per-volume leads and ASGe scans (start with nos. 47 and 89 for the keys and one 'doc. in cifre' volume) before any can be vetted.

vetting_note: Possible decipherment enclosed; no images. Manus 1846991 (JSON read 6 Nov 2026), Marsili 75/C item 45: '10 novembre 1708. Lettera in cifre c. 91rv. All'interno del bifoglio cifrato, forse allegata la sua decifrazione che riguarda la protezione di Roma e utilizzo di fondi economici'; the scripts are given as 'Corsive settecentesche, cifra'. The cataloguer read a clear sheet inside the cipher bifolio and summarised its content, so the letter may well be deciphered on the spot; that can only be settled on the leaf. Frati, Catalogo dei manoscritti Marsili (1928, BUB PDF read) p. 88 lists 75/C as 150+ letters signed by Paolucci with no note on cipher; Ms. 73 holds 'le attestazioni dei due segretari per la consegna delle cifre' (key handover) and AAV Segreteria di Stato registers would hold the clear minute. Web searches (Paolucci/Marsili 1708 cifra; Marsili 1708-09 papal army correspondence) found no edition or study; known.py 'Marsili 75', 'Paolucci', 'Marsili', 'Comacchio': no duplicate. Needs BUB scans of cc. 91-92 (not digitised, no image link in Manus).
